camel_example: aliyun ros SignalResource --region cn-hangzhou --Status SUCCESS --UniqueId '27c7347b-352a-4377-accf-63d361c10000' --LogicalResourceId WebServer --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --StackId '4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000'
description_en: Sends a signal to a resource in a stack
description_zh: 您可以调用本接口对指定资源栈的资源发送信号，与ALIYUN::ROS::WaitCondition配合使用以控制资源栈的执行流程
kebab_example: aliyun ros signal-resource --stack-id 4a6c9851-3b0f-4f5f-b4ca-a14bf6910000 --status SUCCESS --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --unique-id 27c7347b-352a-4377-accf-63d361c10000 --logical-resource-id WebServer --region cn-hangzhou
name: SignalResource

parameters.help_en:
The status of the signal. Failure signals can cause stack creation or update to fail. If all signals are warnings, the stack cannot be created or updated. Valid values:

SUCCESS

FAILURE

WARNING
parameters.help_zh:
信号的状态。故障信号会导致无法创建或更新资源栈，如果所有信号都是警告信号，则将无法创建或更新资源栈。取值：

SUCCESS
FAILURE
WARNING
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the stack. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 资源栈所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/131035.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the signal. The ID must be 1 to 64 characters in length. If multiple signals are sent to a single resource, each signal must have a unique ID
parameters.help_zh: 信号的唯一ID。长度为1~64个字符。如果向单个资源发送多个信号（例如发信号通知等待条件），则每个信号都需要不同的信息ID
parameters.name: unique_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests.

The token can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-) and underscores (_).

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/134212.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求的幂等性。 该值由客户端生成，并且必须是全局唯一的。   
长度最大为64个字符，可包含英文字符、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。  
更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/134212.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The logical ID of the resource as defined in the template
parameters.help_zh: 资源逻辑ID，即模板中资源的名称
parameters.name: logical_resource_id
